convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for NRTR indicator and #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> for position management, requiring recreation of both custom indicator logic and external library trading functions

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of selected timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: NRTR DnValue signal triggers BUY_Close when BuyPosClose is true and DnValue[0] is non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE (buffer[1] additional check with BuyPosOpen && BuyPosClose)
NRTR UpValue signal triggers SELL_Close when SellPosClose is true and UpValue[0] is non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE (buffer[0] additional check with SellPosOpen && SellPosClose)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses

custom_logic_notes: NRTR indicator has 4 buffers: buffer[0]=Up channel line, buffer[1]=Dn channel line, buffer[2]=Up signal, buffer[3]=Dn signal. Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). Two-stage close logic: primary close on signal reversal (buffers 2/3), secondary close on channel line confirmation (buffers 0/1) requiring both open and close flags enabled. Recount mechanism retries signal reading on CopyBuffer failure. IsNewBar class controls per-bar execution. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Must recreate NRTR custom indicator logic (4-buffer channel system with breakout signals). TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be fully replaced - it wraps BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose with margin mode logic, global variable management, and position existence checks. Signal bar indexing (SignalBar=1) means signals lag by one bar. The Recount static variable pattern needs careful handling to avoid missed signals on data errors.
